caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design of a glass pitcher on a beige background. The pitcher is rendered with clear and light blue-gray hues, giving it a transparent appearance. The pitcher is shown in profile, with a rectangular body, flared rim, prominent spout, and a curved handle attached to the right side. The body of the pitcher features an etched decorative motif: a central arrangement of five stylized white flowers with stems and leaves. To the left of the main pitcher image, there are two smaller, detailed sketches. The upper sketch, labeled "Design of Spout," renders the spout from a front-facing perspective, showing the detail on the rim and a small, symmetrical ornament just below the spout edge. The lower sketch is labeled "Design on Front of Pitcher (Actual Size)" and presents an intricate, symmetrical motif composed of swirling patterns, leaf-like designs, and cross-hatched elements; it is shown as a cut-out outline with precise black ink lines. The main drawing and studies are executed in a combination of muted colors and precise black linework, and the paper shows spots and signs of age.
title: Pitcher
